title: Define package-manager manifest contract
summary: Distribution readiness calls out package-manager manifests as a missing graduation gate, but the repository does not yet define a deterministic manifest format for what would be published. Define a simple manifest schema plus generator/validator hooks so future packaging work has auditable inputs.
expectedFailureModes: Future packaging work ships without a deterministic manifest, causing drift between docs and published artifacts.
Manifest generation depends on machine-local state or versions, making it non-reproducible.
Readiness docs claim a manifest exists while validators do not enforce its presence or schema.
nextAction: Extend distribution-readiness to emit a draft package-manager manifest section (schema + empty placeholders), add a validator hook, and document the contract in docs/distribution-readiness.md.
